title: PlayerStorage
description: Basic library for per player data storages.
body:

# PlayerStorage
PlayerStorage is a library datapack that allows other datapacks to easily make and manage their own storages that have different versions for each player. For a guide on how to use this for your own datapack check out the [GitHub](https://github.com/HappyNatalie/playerstorage).
